missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Manner of action. 'Спокойно' modifies the verb 'ответил', describing how he answered, without agitation. Placed right before the verb, it is the standard position for a manner adverb.
Strategic focus: Imperative manner. 'Спокойно' modifies the command 'говори', telling someone to speak in a calm way. Following the imperative, it gives reassuring advice in everyday speech.
Strategic focus: Peaceful state. 'Спокойно' describes the manner of 'спят', painting the sleep as untroubled. The adverb adds atmosphere to a simple statement of location.
Strategic focus: Impersonal predicative. Here 'спокойно' is the predicate of an impersonal sentence, meaning 'it is calm here'. There is no subject, just a description of the atmosphere of the place.
Strategic focus: Manner of motion. 'Спокойно' modifies 'идёт', describing an unhurried, relaxed walk. The adverb colours the movement rather than its direction.
Strategic focus: Standalone reassurance. Used alone, 'спокойно' functions as 'easy now' or 'calm down', a one-word command to relax. It is a common way to steady someone who is upset.
Strategic focus: Calm process. 'Спокойно' modifies 'обсудили', showing the discussion stayed level-headed. Before the verb, it stresses the manner of a completed action.
Strategic focus: Reassuring permission. 'Спокойно' softens 'остаться', meaning you may stay without worry. Here it shades into the sense of 'feel free to', a warm conversational nuance.
Strategic focus: Relaxed position. 'Спокойно' modifies 'лежит', describing the cat's untroubled rest. The adverb adds a peaceful tone to a static scene.
Strategic focus: Impersonal description. 'Спокойно' acts as a predicative describing the feel of home, joined by 'и' to 'тихо'. Both words describe the atmosphere with no grammatical subject.
